summary: Round r1 (restricted network; data hosts blocked). All empirical items are PENDING. Q1 (export basket and product/partner HHI), Q2 (goods trade deficit and trend) and Q3 (quality-standard failures blocking exports) are designed but unanswered. Thirty-one source leads recorded, reused from the shared register and upstream agents (04A, 05C, 07B, 18C, 21A, 21E): Department of Customs trade books and portal, Nepal Trade Portal, TEPC, NRB Current Macroeconomic and Financial Situation (BoP basis), MoF Economic Surveys, UN Comtrade, ITC Trade Map and export-potential study, WITS, UNCTADstat, WTO TPR 2025 (Secretariat and Government reports), ePing and SPS IMS, DFTQC, Tea and Coffee Board, Indian DGFT notifications, Treaty of Trade, Enterprise Surveys and LPI 2023. The export basket is specified on Nepal-reported FY data with mirror CY data as a separate check; RCA is not recomputed (05C owns it). Trade balance is kept on customs and BoP bases separately, with exchange-rate effects separated in USD. The standards-barrier register is designed; no case is asserted without a primary instrument. No numbers are recorded.

findings.claim: Informal India-Nepal trade across the open border is not captured in customs or mirror data and is excluded from the baseline.
findings.note: Known coverage gap; direction of bias unknown; noted in uncertainty.

findings.note: Accepted challenge from 21C; consistent with CLAUDE.md rule 7.

data_gaps: Every empirical value: no primary document could be downloaded in r1.
Customs trade books after FY2022/23 (FY2023/24-FY2025/26) not located at document level.
No Nepal-specific consolidated register of SPS/TBT rejections exists; must be assembled from ePing, Indian notifications and DFTQC records.
Informal cross-border trade with India is unmeasured.
Nepal Bureau of Standards and Metrology document-level URLs not located (portal URL from general knowledge).

assumptions.text: HHI at HS 4-digit on Nepal-reported FY data is the primary concentration measure; mirror CY data are a separate check.
RCA table owned by 05C and referenced, not duplicated.

challenges.text: Please expose the Nepal-reported FY HS 4-digit basket used as the RCA check series with its observation ids so 12A and 05C share one series; 12A will not compute a separate RCA.
12A takes services-export totals from 21E's BPM6 category matrix; please keep the IT/BPO-as-remittance misrecording issue explicit so the services export baseline is labelled accordingly.
Electricity exports appear in customs merchandise data and NRB BoP; confirm which classification 22B uses so the goods trade balance is not double-counted.
Nepal Bureau of Standards and Metrology (nbsm) is not in the source catalog; propose adding it (tier 1) for the quality-standards register.

uncertainty: High: no value retrieved. Structural uncertainties: (i) customs FY vs mirror CY data differ in timing, valuation (CIF/FOB) and coverage; (ii) HHI depends on aggregation level; (iii) re-export and tariff-arbitrage episodes (edible oils) distort basket and concentration; (iv) informal India trade unmeasured; (v) BoP and customs goods balances differ by construction; (vi) 2026 Indian import restrictions and LDC graduation (21A/18C) may change market access within the baseline window; (vii) standards-barrier evidence is fragmentary and press-led until instruments are retrieved.

export_basket.structure: Table by FY x HS 4-digit (top 25 + residual) and by FY x partner (top 15 + residual), NPR_current_bn and USD_current_mn with documented exchange rate; services credits by BPM6 category appended from 21E
export_basket.rca_reference: Revealed comparative advantage is NOT recomputed here; see research/findings/05/05C-r1.json specific.rca_table (Balassa RCA on mirror data, 3-year windows). 12A supplies the Nepal-reported FY basket used as its check series.

indices.name: product_HHI
indices.formula: sum_j s_j^2 over HS 4-digit export shares; normalised HHI* = (HHI-1/N)/(1-1/N)

indices.name: extensive_margin_count
indices.description: number of HS 6-digit lines exported above a documented threshold

concentration_indices.periods: Nepal FY (customs) and calendar year (mirror) computed separately; never mixed
methodological_issues: HHI sensitive to aggregation level (HS 4 vs 6)
re-export spikes (edible oils) inflate concentration temporarily
mirror data omit informal trade and have CIF/FOB gap

trade_balance_series.trend_method: Descriptive: level, share of GDP, and decomposition of change into export and import contributions and (USD series) exchange-rate effect; petroleum and edible-oil re-export components shown separately

quality_standard_barriers_register.note: Candidate case families to verify from primary instruments only: Indian quarantine/lab-testing requirements on Nepali agri-food, 2026 Indian import restrictions reported in press, EU regulations mapped by 18C (CBAM, EUDR), private-standard certification in carpets/pashmina/tea. No case is asserted until an instrument is retrieved.
